task: Phase 2 — Live chalkboard + multi-subject visual teaching engine

liveChalkboard.textReveal: CSS clip-path chalk wipe per object, LTR for maths/KaTeX and RTL for Arabic (data-write-dir), 800ms cubic-bezier
liveChalkboard.strokeDrawing: SVG stroke-dashoffset drawing for lines, boxes, arrows and graph strokes (pathLength=1)
liveChalkboard.erase: removed objects stay for a 280ms chalk-fade before the layout collapses
liveChalkboard.reducedMotion: media query + html[data-reduced-motion=true] overrides; no rasterisation, KaTeX stays selectable
liveChalkboard.proof: DOM evidence: chalkWriteRtl running (800ms) on Arabic objects; chalkStrokeDraw on geometry strokes

graphLayer.gapFixed: plot_* objects previously rendered nowhere; graphs from the AI now appear on the board
graphLayer.deterministic: pure coordinate mapping, clamped to [-10,10], no executable input

presets.architecture: compositional primitives (plot_*/draw_*/labels/KaTeX); no bespoke widgets, no schema change — the proven 23-action schema is untouched

fixtures.labelled: every title starts with «عرض تجريبي» and the board shows «عرض تجريبي — بيانات وهمية»
fixtures.access: development-only ?fixture=<key> parameter; never in production, never in a normal student session

browserResults.physics: 1 graph svg, 5 strokes, 3 arrowheads, badge visible
browserResults.chemistry: 1 graph svg, 2 bond strokes, 3 atom dots

math.question: اشرح حل معادلة تربيعية بالتحليل إلى عوامل، وارسم تمثيلها البياني على السبورة.

geometry.question: أنشئ مثلثًا على السبورة وارسم ارتفاعه، ثم اشرح قانون مساحة المثلث.
geometry.gap: the model drew points without vertex labels in this run

latency.streaming: NOT implemented — blocker and measured path reported below
latency.firstVisibleContent: first board stroke starts as soon as the lesson arrives (0.8s measured in Phase 1), audio loads in parallel

streamingAnalysis.blocker: lesson validation is whole-document: cross-segment source-id checks, board-state progression (validateActions), katex pass, repair loop regenerates the full lesson on any failure
measuredPath: 1. server emits SSE frames after validating each segment against the running board state (1-2 days)
2. client renders a segment as soon as it validates and prefetches its audio (client change is small)
3. repair stays whole-lesson but only for the failing segment; provisional badge until the stream closes
4. credit charge stays once per request; duplicate SSE frames ignored by requestId

tests.new: tests/visual-presets.test.ts (5 tests: graph mapping/clamping, presets strict-schema + engine + katex, fixtures labelled + valid, fixture routing contract)
